nodes.code_summary: The code implements a GPU-batched histopathology physics frontend (HistopathologyPhysicsFrontend) performing Ruifrok-Johnston H&E stain deconvolution into a 4-channel stain-structural representation alongside ImageNet-normalized RGB, with training-only D4 symmetry, 3D optical-density stain-basis rotation, cross-center rfft2 low-frequency amplitude mixing, radial MTF perturbation, and intra-class cross-center mixup. It trains a BatchNorm-free multi-scale architecture (PathologyMultiScaleStainNet) pairing pretrained ConvNeXt-Small and SwinV2-Tiny backbones (with early-stage ExtrapolativeMixStyle2d) and a 4-scale Zero-Phase 2D-FFT StainSpectralPyramidEncoder, fused via D4 concentric ring pooling, GeM pooling, and Gated-Attention MIL. Models are optimized with differential stage-wise AdamW, WarmupGatedEMA, balanced domain-class sampling, and UnseenCenterBalancedAccuracyLoss (symmetric balanced BCE, soft balanced accuracy, pairwise AUROC margin, class-conditional CORAL, and GRL domain alignment). Validation is performed leak-free on the fixed validation set using 8-view D4 TTA, followed by a runtime-budgeted post-validation refit on merged train and validation data split via StratifiedGroupKFold.

nodes.code_summary: The pipeline uses a GPU-batched HistopathologyPhysicsFrontend performing Beer-Lambert H&E stain deconvolution, training-only D4 symmetry, 3D OD stain-basis rotation, cross-center rfft2 low-frequency amplitude mixing, radial MTF perturbation, and intra-class cross-center mixup, producing ImageNet-normalized RGB and a 4-channel stain-structural tensor. Validation uses 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold within train.csv (4 folds trained) with 8-view D4-TTA, guarded equal-center Platt calibration, and family-balanced OOF ensemble weighting evaluated on the untouched validation.csv.

The previous run failed with a `TimeoutError` at the 1-hour limit during `test_log_odds_stage1 = run_pipeline_inference(...)` because `TRAIN_RUNTIME_CEILING_SEC = 3350.0` only reserved `160s` for post-Stage-1 validation and test inference across 9,202 patches—whereas 8-view D4-TTA across multiple DINOv2-Base and SwinV2-Base folds actually required ~940–1,140s—and `train_pathology_checkpoint` lacked prospective epoch + SoupCheck budget accounting. Model Architecture & Training: BatchNorm-free PathologyMultiScaleStainNet pairs 4-scale DINOv2-Base-reg4 (266x266 reflect-padded with ViT-Adapters) or SwinV2-Base backbones (with early-stage ExtrapolativeMixStyle2d hooks) with a 4-scale Zero-Phase 2D-FFT StainSpectralPyramidEncoder, multi-scale pyramid fusion, D4 concentric ring pooling, GeM pooling, Gated-Attention MIL, and a SymmetricCosinePrototypeClassifier; trained with differential AdamW, WarmupGatedEMA, Top-2 epoch weight-space souping, and UnseenCenterBalancedAccuracyLoss (GroupDRO balanced BCE + soft BA, V-REx, per-center symmetry/midpoint penalties, pairwise AUROC margin, conditional CORAL, and GRL). Validation & Inference: Leak-free 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold (grouped by group_id, stratified by center_id and label) within train.csv with 4-view D4-TTA and guarded equal-center Platt log-odds calibration evaluated on untouched validation.csv, followed by a 2-fold full-development refit blended in log-odds space for test inference.

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing applies per-patch Shrinkage-Regularized Adaptive Macenko (SRAM) stain deconvolution fitted strictly on training slides, paired with Dirichlet-Macenko stain/MTF augmentation and D4 symmetry transforms during training. Feature engineering extracts 148 domain features (126 base + 22 interactions across 7 families: cubical topology, multi-scale structure tensors, concentric multizone stats, chromatin GLCM, cytomorphometry, color physics, and interactions), processed via leak-free median imputation, quantile Winsorization, and RobustScaler/arcsinh scaling. The primary model is a BatchNorm-free trimodal TopoStainDINOv2PyramidNet combining multi-depth DINOv2 ViT-S/14 (with registers), a native 256x256 Stain-Physics DoG Pyramid, Concentric Zone Gated-MIL, a 7-Family Periodic-Linear Set-Transformer with bidirectional cross-attention, and a zero-bias Bipolar vMF Hyperspherical Head, trained with a CenterInvariantBalancedAccuracyLoss (class-balanced BCE, soft balanced error, V-REx, and hyperspherical alignment), LLRD AdamW, EMA, and center/class/slide-balanced batches alongside LightGBM and XGBoost GBDTs. Validation uses Leave-One-Center-Out and 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold on train.csv for GBDT blending and neural fold selection, evaluates 4-view D4-TTA ensemble inference on untouched validation.csv, and performs a Stage 2 post-validation refit on merged train+validation data for final test inference.

nodes.code_summary: Data preprocessing and feature engineering use a RAM-cached uint8 dataset feeding a GPU-batched HistopathologyPhysicsFrontend that computes ImageNet-normalized RGB and a 4-channel Ruifrok-Johnston Beer-Lambert H&E optical density representation (standardized H, standardized E, nuclear fraction, and pigment-gated 5x5 chromatin contrast), with training-only D4 symmetry, OD stain-basis rotation, cross-center rfft2 low-frequency amplitude mixing, radial MTF, and intra-class cross-center mixup. The model (PathologyMultiScaleStainNet) pairs BatchNorm-free 4-scale ConvNeXt-Base and SwinV2-Base backbones with a Zero-Phase 2D-FFT StainSpectralPyramidEncoder, stain-gated Split-IBN fusion, D4 concentric ring pooling, GeM pooling, and gated-attention MIL, trained via stage-wise differential AdamW, WarmupGatedEMA, and UnseenCenterBalancedAccuracyLoss (Group-DRO class-balanced BCE, soft balanced accuracy, pairwise AUROC margin, deep supervision, and class-conditional Deep CORAL). Validation uses 3-fold StratifiedGroupKFold (grouped by group_id, stratified by center and label) within train.csv with 8-view D4-TTA checkpoint selection, family-pooled worst-center-guarded calibration, and simplex log-odds blending evaluated on the untouched validation.csv prior to runtime-guarded full-dev refit.
